caption: The drawing depicts a landscape with two prominent trees and a small structure positioned between them. The tree on the left has a drooping, willow-like appearance with dark brown trunk and branches, and leaves rendered in a subdued brownish-green color, hanging in clusters. The tree on the right is more upright and symmetrical, with a darker trunk and dense foliage detailed in a repetitive pattern, giving it a more compact and oval shape. In the center is a small, dark brown structure resembling a memorial or urn, adorned with a decorative finial on top and some engraving or marking on its front. The ground is colored in muted greens and browns, with tufts of grass or small plants at the bases of the trees. The background consists of softly blended pastel blue and peach tones, suggesting a sky with clouds and possibly early morning or late afternoon light. The composition is centered on these three main elements, and the drawing is framed by a wide margin of plain, off-white paper.
title: Memorial Picture
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
